plan.preprocessing: RGB; square224 bilinear antialias; original per-model ImageNet normalization
plan.question: Does fixed four-flip TTA improve the current S46 four-model F1-checkpoint candidate?
plan.control: Fresh FP32 identity-only four-member mean; separates precision from views
plan.scope: Already selected exploratory development validation, not independent test
plan.material_gate: >=+.005 accuracy over S46 with no macro-F1/MEL recall decline, and accuracy above FP32 identity
plan.study_limit: Exactly identity control and one four-view average; no view/model/weight/checkpoint search
